title: Physical damage
wikitext:
{{redirect|Physical Damage|the passive skill|Physical Damage (passive skill)}} '''Physical damage''' is one of the five [[damage type]]s. It is the most common and the only one reduced by [[armour]], rather than by a [[resistance]]. Most physical damage comes from weapon [[attack]]s, but some [[spell]]s deal physical damage as well. Physical [[damage over time]] can be inflicted with the [[Bleeding|bleed]] [[ailment]]. Every 10 points of [[strength]] give a 2% bonus to physical damage from [[melee]] attacks. The [[Iron Grip]] keystone passive extends this bonus to also apply to physical damage from [[projectile]]s. The {{il|Iron Grip Support}} gem applies the same effect to a single skill. ==Gems== A list of [[gem]]s with the [[gem tag]]: [[:Category:Physical (gem tag)|Physical]] Skills with the [[Keyword#Attack|attack]] keyword will do any physical damage of the weapon used and apply the appropriate physical damage passive skills. Some spells also deal physical damage. ===Attack skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Physical" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Spell skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Physical" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Other skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Physical" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Support gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Physical" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ==Base items== The following base items are related to physical damage: {{Drop enabled base item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Physical%Damage%" AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem") |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Unique items== ===Global flat added physical damage=== [[Unique item]]s that have global flat increases to physical damage. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageID=items._pageID |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%added_physical_damage%" AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%local%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Global Attack

|stat_column4_stat_format=add |stat_column4_stat1_id=base_physical_damage_%_to_convert_to_chaos }} ==Passive skills== Many [[passive skill]]s throughout the tree increase physical damage, but most are restricted to particular sources. Passives exist to increase physical damage from the following sources: * [[Melee]] ** [[One-Handed Melee Weapons]] ** [[Two-Handed Melee Weapons]] ** [[Sword]]s ** [[Mace]]s ** [[Axe]]s ** [[Claw]]s ** [[Dagger]]s ** [[Staff|Staves]] * [[Bow]]s * [[Wand]]s * [[Dual wielding]] All of these categories of passive skills will only increase the physical damage of attacks, not spells. Passives which increase [[projectile]] damage, and the {{il|Iron Will Support}} support gem, apply their bonuses to all types of damage, not just physical. ===Base passive skills=== These passive skills grant unrestricted physical damage bonuses. This includes physical damage generated by spells such as {{il|Ethereal Knives}} and {{il|Shockwave Totem}}. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "physical_damage_+%" }}
